### About Us

![](https://www.aurumequity.com/images/about.jpg)

**Set up in 2012, led by a team of qualified and experienced professionals, Aurum Equity**
**Partners LLP is an India-focused Investment Banking Firm providing services across**
**Mergers and Acquisitions, Fundraising, Restructuring, Corporate Advisory Valuation**

- Over 5 decades of cumulative “deal experience” for mid-market and large
Corporates, Multinational Corporations and Institutional Financial Investors
- Team has successfully closed 200+ transactions across all sectors of the Indian
economy
- Scrutinized and assessed 2,000+ deals all in all

We believe our Philosophy and Approach to Business is best represented by our tagline **“Trust is Everything”**, thereby encapsulating our **Character, Competence** and **Connections** into a single goal – Building long term **“Trust”**.

### Leadership

The Aurum Team comes with over 5 decades of hardcore deal experience across
sizes and sectors. The team is also supported by Strategic Partners
who are veterans in one or more industries with 25+ years of experience

![](https://www.aurumequity.com/images/CEO/22765538.jpg)

### Sanjay Bansal

[**Founder & Managing Partner**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sanjay-bansal-148b88/?original_referer=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Egoogle%2Ecom%2F&originalSubdomain=in)

A veteran investment banker with a knack for concluding large, complex
transactions. Sanjay has 30+ years of experience, with a deep and on-the-
ground understanding and exposure to handling 160+ mid & large-sized
transactions, across a range of sectors. Over the years Sanjay has developed an
expertise that requires a nuanced perspective of the client’s business, as well as,
the macro environment impacting the client’s decisions. Sanjay is a passionate
supporter and enabler of the entrepreneurial ecosystem in India and encourages
aspiring & budding entrepreneurs through angel investments. Sanjay is a charter
member of The Indus Entrepreneurs (TiE) and the Indian Angel Network

![](https://www.aurumequity.com/images/testimonial/67947827.jpg)

### Vikram Bihani

[**Senior Partner**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/vikrambihani/?original_referer=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Egoogle%2Ecom%2F&originalSubdomain=in)

Vikram is an experienced Investment Banker with around 25 years of experience
and 85+ transactions under his belt. He is a graduate of the Indian Institute of
Management, Bangalore. He started his career with Ambit Corporate Finance,
post-which he co-founded Mosaic Capital Services, another Investment Bank.
He was the Director and on the Investment Committee of a USD 500 million
real estate fund, is a Board Observer on the Indian Subsidiary of a Nasdaq
listed MNC and is an Investor, Director and mentor in few startups.
He is the Past President of the Bangalore Chapter of the Entrepreneurs'
Organisation and is on the Managing Committee of the prestigious Bangalore Club.
